items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I think Bud Scott was playing banjo from there.

ctx.x: Tucker. Tucker. It was the first slide. Slide trumpet player I had to sing.

But that wasn't long. I was a boy. I was around about 18. And I used to go up to the guy and play. He was with John Robichaux band then. That's the time they had old Brad Frank playing a piccolo. He was a wonderful piccolo from memory. He didn't play anything. He was good. And then that's Robichaux band. You see. John Robichaux. I believe Andrew Kimball. I think Bud Scott was playing banjo from there. What's up with him? I don't know. They didn't have any drums at that time. Didn't have the drums. No. You know…
Did you play with Louie Cottrell in your band ever?

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: You remember Bud Scott and Johnny Saint-Cyr both played those six string bandages?

ctx.x: You remember Bud Scott and Johnny Saint-Cyr both played those six string bandages? Six string.
Well all the other played with us played six string. We never did have a first string. Who were they?
